City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
November 7, 2011
07:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
PRESENTATIONS
Presentation of in lieu donation by outgoing Railroad Museum Foundation Boardmember Dave Bradley to Railroad Museum Foundation.
Presentation of check from proceeds of the Mayors Cup Golf Classic.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Demands
b.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
c.
Report dealing with economic development activities. RECEIVE AND FILE.
d.
Report dealing with activities of the parks department. RECEIVE AND FILE.
e.
Report submitting investment and treasury report for the month of September. RECEIVE AND FILE.
f.
Report dealing with activities of the public works department for the month of October. RECEIVE AND FILE.
g.
Report requesting approval of a three-year Memorandum of Understanding with the Lomita City
Employees' Association regarding wages, hours and terms and conditions of employment. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
h.
Report recommending approval of resolution amending Resolution No 1981-563 establishing a compensation plan. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report recommending approval of proposal from Lincoln National Life Insurance Company for Term Life Insurance for full time employees and authorizing the City Manager to execute the agreement. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
j.
Report recommending approval of resolution reaffirming Employer Paid Member Contributions under the California Public Employees' Retirement System. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
k.
Approval of resolution amending the ICMA-RC Deferred Compensation Plan to allow participants to take loans from the plan. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
l.
Report recommending approval of professional services agreement with CETECH Engineering for design work relative to various CIP projects in an amount not to exceed $25,024. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
m.
Report recommending approval of Amendment No. 2 to the professional services agreement with CivilSource, Inc. for construction management and inspection services for Phase 1A Waterline and Roadway, Phase 1B Waterline and Roadway, and the Pacific Coast Highway Water Main Replacement projects in an amount not to exceed $141,178. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
n.
Report recommending installation of red curb on the west side of Oak Street between 465 feet and 490 feet south of the south curb line of Pacific Coast Highway. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARING
6.
TENTATIVE TRACT MAP NO. 71504 Public Hearing to consider adoption of a resolution approving Tentative Tract Map No. 71504, a subdivision of one lot into two lots of 13,145 square feet each, located at 2067 W. 240th Street.
Presented by Asst. City Manager Sugano.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
7.
COMMISSION APPOINTMENTS Report recommending that appointments be made to vacancies on the following boards/commissions: Public Safety and Traffic Commission, Railroad Museum Foundation Board, Parks and Recreation Commission and Tree Commission.
Presented by City Manager Tomita.
CLOSED SESSION
CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - Anticipated litigation, Government Code Section 54956.9(b)
Number of cases: one
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
